surface_mechanism_description: The alternate deposition of ZnCl2 and O2 on the sapphire substrate is governed by a self-limiting mechanism, as evidenced by the fact that the film thickness depends only on the growth cycles and the surface remains smooth. The growth rate corresponds to half the c-axis length of hexagonal ZnO, indicating that each cycle deposits a single Zn layer.
evidence: It is noteworthy that the rate corresponds to just a half-length of the c axis of hexagonal ZnO, indicating that the alternate deposition of ZnCl2 and O2 on the substrate is governed by a self-limiting mechanism. This was also confirmed by the facts that the film thickness was dependent only on the growth cycles and that the surface was quite smooth.
